profile.headline: Senior Manager, Software Engineering at The Home Depot
profile.summary:
Over the course of my career where I have been a manager and responsible for a team of software developers, my number one priority was building a team who enjoy working with each other and share a passion for development. While hiring I look for a good team fit over the perfect set of technical skills. The ability to get the right fit for the team who has the drive to learn made sharing knowledge and supporting one-another effortless. The technical part can be learned as long as the team is willing to work together.

Culture is a major part of what I have been describing. Culture is the sum of everyone who works on a team and in an organization. My approach is to make culture more obvious. By being acutely aware of what culture we want to be a part of, we can be more aware of what a good citizen looks like. How we work with each other, motivate each other and what we accomplish. Thus, creating accountability and dependency on each other.

positions.title: Software Engineer Senior Manager Retail Media+
User Interface Architect
positions.description:
Johnson & Johnson Health and Wellness programs cover a wide range of health issues from weight management, smoking cessation and stress management to disease management - diabetes, pain management and medication adherence as well as behavioral health - insomnia and depression.
My responsibility is to ensure all of the JnJHWS products presentation layer architecture is well engineered, maintainable, operable, and aligns to business vision/strategy. Additionally, I am responsible for working with the product team to be accountable to our end-users, establishing and testing to meet quantifiable usability-based goals to ensure a great user experience.

-Responsible for the architecture of the presentation layer for each modality of our products
-Work with the Chief Architect to define and manage the user interface roadmap and strategy
-Lead, direct and mentor the software development team in the design of the software
-Identify and/or evaluate emerging technologies
-Research new developments in industry, regulations and industry best practices
-Articulate and plan for scalability, manageability, testability, security, maintainability, usability, functionality
-Work closely with other Architects, business sponsors, development team, project managers, QA, and O&M and ensure the solutions are consistent, reusable and align with the technology vision
-Clearly express risks and appropriately escalate issues for resolution
-Own Non-functional requirements and prioritization around our Company's products user interface modalities
-Perform periodic heuristic evaluation of our products to determine if we are following good usability design principles
-Work with UX lead to facilitate various types of usability, accessibility, and user acceptance testing activities across all product lines
-Define technology standards for presentation layers of our products
-Direct engineering teams in our architecture standards and technologies

positions.title: Manager - eCommerce Web Development
positions.description:
As eCommerce Web Development manager I have responsibility over leading a highly talented web development team.  The web development team is responsible for front end development of such sites as Online Ordering on Dominos.com and Pizza Tracker.  

Manage the web development team
-Develop, mentor, train, manage, and support the team of highly talented web developers
-Foster an innovative startup culture within a corporate environment where risk taking is encouraged but deadlines and objectives must be met
-Responsible for web architecture decisions to ensure well thought out design and conceptualization, taking into account the suggestions and priorities of the solution architecture 

e-Commerce Web Architecture 
-Architect web solutions to support Domino’s eCommerce functionality and business requirements
-Collaborate with marketing, agency and in-house designers, requirements analysts, and technical project team on web designs
-Apply basic user interface design skills when implementing features

Web Development
-Write, modify, and debug e-Commerce web user interfaces
-Work closely with the team to ensure they are effectively writing, modifying and debugging e-Commerce web interface
-Generate tests for User Interfaces
-Rapidly prototype new ideas and concepts 
-Lead the transition of developed applications and systems into testing and production phases for all front end web development work
-Estimate the duration of design and development tasks
-Support all production applications that the team is responsible for developing

positions.title: Specialist - Web Developer
positions.description:
Specialist - Web Development

Software Development Responsibilities
-Write, modify, and debug eCommerce applications and solutions
-Develop web software with Javascript and HTML/CSS technologies
-Design unit tests for front-end application code
-Rapid prototyping of new ideas & concepts
-Estimate the duration of design & development tasks

eCommerce Solution Architecture
-Collaborate with other architects and developers on the eCommerce platform architecture
-Design horizontally-scalable architectures for all eCommerce client devices (web and native platforms)

My Qualifications
-Mastery of JavaScript, AJAX, jQuery, and JSON development
-Mastery of HTML and CSS development, understanding of HTML5
-Experience with JSP, Java, or C development
-4+ years experience building JavaScript/HTML/CSS front-ends for viewing on multiple browsers and operating systems (Chrome, IE, Firefox, Safari, etc.)
-8+ years development/architecture experience in a web environment
-5+ years experience with Unix, Linux, Apache, Tomcat, MySQL, Perl
-Active debugging with Firebug and all browser equivalents
-Test Driven Development experience in an agile engineering environment (qUnit, jUnit)
-Mastery of bullet-proof standards and compliant front-end development
-Bachelor's degree in computer technology, computer science
-Excellent team player with good communication skills
-Highly motivated by difficult problems & cutting edge technology
-Lots of open-source project participation
